label: IotaWatt Retention
info: Phase 2 archive-only maintenance. Calls maintain_iotawatt_archive() daily at 03:40 America/Denver and alerts if no successful run is recorded for more than 36 hours. This flow contains no pruning SQL; pruning remains locked in IotaWattRetentionState.

nodes.name: Archive succeeded
Check last archive success
nodes.template:
SELECT LastArchiveSuccessUTC,
       TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, LastArchiveSuccessUTC, UTC_TIMESTAMP()) AS AgeHours,
       ReadyToPrune
FROM v_iotawatt_pruning_readiness
WHERE Id=1;

nodes.name: Alert if older than 36h
Build archive failure alert
Archive only — pruning locked until Grafana migration
nodes.info: The database state requires GrafanaMigrated=1, ConsumersMigrated=1, and PruningEnabled=1 before pruning can be implemented or called. This tab intentionally calls only maintain_iotawatt_archive().
